en: Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park or garden with a wide central path lined by young trees and benches. On the left is a large wooden pavilion or bandstand with a tiled, pointed roof. In the right foreground a woman in a long white dress sits on a bench. In the background stands a multi‑storey institutional building with a central clock‑tower and steep roof; faint signage on the façade suggests a German word. The overall style evokes an early‑20th‑century European spa town or civic garden.
